title: The Hitler Bloodline: From the Secret Origins to the Extinction of the Lineage
topic: The Hitler Bloodline: From the Secret Origins to the Extinction of the Lineage
premise: This forensic investigation traces the genealogical labyrinth of the Hitler family from 19th-century peasant roots in the Waldviertel to the deliberate pact made by surviving relatives to extinguish their own bloodline. Utilizing declassified intelligence dossiers, wartime medical records, and primary genealogical archives, we uncover the biological reality behind the dictator and the modern remnants of a cursed legacy.

acts_outline.synopsis: Examines the disputed paternity of Alois Hitler and the deep-seated genealogical anxieties that plagued Adolf Hitler throughout his life, exploring archival parish records and the shadow of incestuous lineage.

acts_outline.act_title: Act II: Shadows of the Inner Circle
acts_outline.synopsis: Traces the lives of Hitler's direct siblings, half-siblings, and extended family as they navigated his rise to power, highlighting friction, extortion, and the desperate efforts of relatives to hide or exploit their familial connection.
key_historical_figures_and_records: Nazi Party Racial Policy Office (Rasse- und Siedlungshauptamt) Files

acts_outline.time_and_place: 1939–1945: New York, Washington D.C., and Liverpool
acts_outline.synopsis: Investigates the turbulent saga of the Hitler branch in the English-speaking world, focusing on William Patrick Hitler's dramatic break from the family, his direct appeal to FDR, and his wartime service in the US Navy.
key_historical_figures_and_records: US Navy Intelligence Dossier on William P. Hitler (1942)

acts_outline.synopsis: Analyzes Allied intelligence operations tasked with interrogating surviving family members, tracking down psychological profiles, and documenting the medical history of the bloodline to understand hereditary factors.

acts_outline.time_and_place: 1955–Present Day: New York, Long Island, and Lower Austria
acts_outline.synopsis: Unveils the covert agreement made by the last surviving descendants to never marry or have children, culminating in the modern genealogical dead-end that definitively sealed the extinction of the Hitler lineage.
